# bioexcel/biobb_model/mutate

## Summary

Class to mutate one amino acid by another in a 3d structure.

Mutate side chain with minimal atom replacement. if the use_modeller property is added the Modeller suite will be used to optimize the side chains.

Nextflow adapter of the [Mutate](https://biobb-model.readthedocs.io/en/latest/model.html#module-model.mutate) building block of [biobb_model](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_model) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_MODEL_MUTATE } from 'bioexcel/biobb_model/mutate'

workflow {
    BIOBB_MODEL_MUTATE(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_pdb_path` | yes | pdb | Input PDB file path |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_pdb_path` | yes | pdb | Output PDB file path |
| `versions_biobb_model` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_model', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Mutate properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_pdb_path: 'pdb']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_model container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_MODEL_MUTATE' {
        ext.properties = [use_modeller: false]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mutation_list` | string | null | Mutation list in the format "Chain:WT_AA_ThreeLeterCode Resnum MUT_AA_ThreeLeterCode" (no spaces between the elements) separated by commas. If no chain is provided as chain code all the chains in the pdb file will be mutated. ie: "A:ALA15CYS" |
| `use_modeller` | boolean | false | Use Modeller suite to optimize the side chains. |
| `modeller_key` | string | null | Modeller license key. |
| `binary_path` | string | "check_structure" | Path to the check_structure executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
